name: Spin 800M
summary: High-throughput, fully automatic clinical chemistry analyzer running 800 photometric tests per hour, up to 1,200 with the optional ISE module. 140 sample positions, a water-cooled 120-position reagent tray, intelligent clot and bubble detection, and a modular design that scales to the Spin 800 M1 and M2 systems.

specs.label: Throughput
specs.value: 800 tests/hour, up to 1,200 tests/hour with ISE

specs.label: ISE module (optional)
specs.value: Indirect Na⁺, K⁺, Cl⁻; 22 µL sample; up to 60,000 tests

specs.label: Sample tray
specs.value: 140 positions, including 25 cooled positions for calibrators and controls

specs.label: Sample probe
specs.value: Liquid level detection, clot detection (full jam, half jam, bubbles), collision protection

specs.label: Reagent tray
specs.value: 120 positions in coaxial disks, water-circulation cooling at 2 – 8 °C

specs.label: Reagent probe
specs.value: Liquid level detection, bubble detection, collision protection

specs.label: Loading
specs.value: Continuous loading and unloading during testing

specs.label: Mixing
specs.value: Independent reagent and sample mixers, three-head mixing bars, two-stage washing

specs.label: Light source
specs.value: Halogen-tungsten lamp, dot light source with dual diaphragm and dual lens

specs.label: Calibration modes
specs.value: Linear (one-point, two-point, multipoint), Logit-Log 4P, Logit-Log 5P, spline, exponential, polynomial, parabola

specs.label: Operating system
specs.value: Windows XP Professional/Home SP2 or later

specs.label: Maintenance
specs.value: Built-in maintenance guide, warning log, water quality monitoring

features: 800 tests per hour, up to 1,200 with the optional ISE module
High sampling precision: 0.1 µL sample and 0.5 µL reagent steps
Water-circulation reagent cooling keeps the tray at 2 – 8 °C
Direct solid heating holds the reaction disk at 37 °C ± 0.1 °C
Intelligent clot detection tells full jams, half jams and bubbles apart
Reagent bubble and real liquid-level detection before aspiration
Vertical and horizontal collision protection on all probes
Independent mixers with three-head bars and two-stage washing
Continuous reagent loading and unloading during testing
Covered sample disk that can be partly opened when needed
Waterproof cover over all electronics with drainage channel
Built-in maintenance guide, warning log and water quality monitoring
Modular: expands to Spin 800 M1 and M2 systems
